results.question: 查询水位站宝应这个月的水位数据（同义词测试：本月 = 当月）。
results.expected_sql:
SELECT r.tm AS '时间', r.z AS '水位(m)'
FROM sl323.st_river_r r
JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON r.stcd = b.stcd
WHERE b.stnm LIKE '%宝应%' AND b.sttp = 'ZZ'
  AND DATE_FORMAT(r.tm, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
  AND r.z IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.tm;
actual_sqls:
SELECT DISTINCT b.stcd, b.stnm, b.sttp, b.rvnm, b.dtmnm
    FROM st_stbprp_b b
    WHERE b.stnm LIKE '%宝应%'
    LIMIT 20
SELECT MAX(tm) as max_tm FROM st_river_r

SELECT 
        r.stcd,
        DATE(r.tm) as dt,
        ROUND(AVG(r.z), 2) as avg_z,
        ROUND(MAX(r.z), 2) as max_z,
        ROUND(MIN(r.z), 2) as min_z,
        COUNT(*) as record_cnt
    FROM st_river_r r
    WHERE r.stcd IN ('{stcd_list}')
      AND r.tm >= '2026-07-01' 
      AND r.tm < '2026-08-01'
      AND r.z IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.stcd, DATE(r.tm)
    ORDER BY r.stcd, dt
    LIMIT 100

SELECT 
        r.stcd,
        ROUND(AVG(r.z), 2) as avg_z,
        ROUND(MAX(r.z), 2) as max_z,
        ROUND(MIN(r.z), 2) as min_z,
        COUNT(*) as total_records,
        MIN(DATE(r.tm)) as first_dt,
        MAX(DATE(r.tm)) as last_dt
    FROM st_river_r r
    WHERE r.stcd IN ('{stcd_list}')
      AND r.tm >= '2026-07-01' 
      AND r.tm < '2026-08-01'
      AND r.z IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.stcd

SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt 
    FROM st_rvfcch_b 
    WHERE STCD IN ('{stcd_list}') 
      AND (WRZ IS NOT NULL OR GRZ IS NOT NULL)

SELECT STCD, WRZ, GRZ FROM st_rvfcch_b 
        WHERE STCD IN ('{stcd_list}')
        LIMIT 10
